_comment: On-demand Pro invocation narrowed to carousels.

algoSignals.signal: Instagram is rewarding carousels with 9-10 slides over shorter ones (April 2026).
algoSignals.evidence: per https://www.adweek.com/social-marketing/instagram-carousel-2026: 'Adam Mosseri noted on the Instagram product blog that 9-10 slide carousels see ~40% higher save rate than 5-slide variants in current rankings.' Date: 2026-04-12.

output.whatsHotNow: Long carousels (9-10 slides), education-formatted, with a hook slide that doubles as the cover thumbnail. Save rate is the dominant ranking signal.
output.whatsCoolingOff: Carousels under 5 slides (treated more like single-image posts). Carousels whose first slide doesn't read as a thumbnail.
